name: Commercial LLM Trained on Customer Support Chats
description: A company plans to fine-tune a large language model on 3 million WhatsApp customer-support conversations and sell API access to the model to other companies as a 'Saudi customer-service AI'.
documentation:
DATA: full chat logs including names, phone numbers, national ID and Iqama numbers, addresses, payment issues and health complaints customers mentioned.
CONSENT: customers were never told their chats would be used to train or sell a model; the privacy policy only mentions 'service improvement'.
DE-IDENTIFICATION: none; the model has been observed reproducing phone numbers and ID numbers from training data.
HOSTING: training and hosting abroad; no transfer assessment; no DPA.
COMMERCIAL USE: model access will be sold to unrelated third parties.
RIGHTS: no mechanism to remove a customer's data from the model on request.
